method: Read-only reconstruction from actual layer io_ready, compute_start/end and request admissions; no simulation or source edits. Event count is number of positive layer-wait intervals overlapping each window, not request count.
causal_limits: Stall and SSU1 nominal-overload temporal overlap is association, not identification of the last I/O block or last completing SSU.
These saved results do not include per-block timelines or per-layer per-SSU completion timestamps; cannot prove all layer stalls were caused by SSU1.
Near-100% utilization on this finite population does not establish absence of HOL on other input profiles.
Overall full-run denominator includes post-completion tail idle; warm-window denominator does not when every card is continuously active.
